name: Tenebrous Cliffs
description: The Tenebrous Cliffs rise sharply above the mountains, forming jagged obsidian ridges shaped by resonance winds. Razorfiends perch along the heights, vampyric scouts watch from hidden spires, and Akhevan ledges serve as vantage points for shadow incursions. The cliffs are treacherous, unstable, and alive with predation.
